TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Ratkin Clans faction.

Translations.Comment: 鼠人 = rat-person, 一族 = clan/tribe. Maintains tribal structure of rat-men.
軍団兵 = legionary. Organized rat-men military units.
徴募兵 = conscript. Forced levy troops.
潜行者 = skulker/sneaker. Stealthy infiltrator units.
長銃兵 = long rifleman. Sharpshooters with technological advantage.
投石兵 = slinger. Simple but effective ranged troops.
火炎兵 = flame trooper. Dangerous experimental flame weapons.
怪物 = monstrosity. Twisted creation of dark rat-men experiments.
アルファ = alpha (katakana). Elite warrior caste of the clans.
大群 = swarm/horde. Masses of vermin and creatures.
滅亡 = doom/destruction, 鐘 = bell. Ominous instrument of fate.
術士 = warlock/dark sorcerer. Master of sinister magic.
族長 = chieftain/clan leader. Cunning and ruthless commander.
潜入者 = infiltrator. Master spy and assassin.
